thread:
alyssa: Morning — quick postmortem follow-up on today's DNS reroute / retry surge. Root cause: stale route TTL + routing race that caused cross-region fanout. Action items below, please ack and add ETA.

ben: ack. can you paste the root cause summary?

alyssa: short summary: when route-update API returned 500, clients fell back to cached resolver results; combined with a recent LB change that pushed region hints -> some traffic retried across regions simultaneously. result: retry storms, duplicate flows, and latency spike.

megan: who owns the routing fix? infra or edge?

raj: infra will own the API circuit-breaker + backoff. simon to handle LB guardrails (canary + rollback). i will own telemetry + alerts.

simon: confirmed. i'll add a canary to limit cross-region fanout and a safety flag in the LB control plane. will draft rollback playbook.

alyssa: Action items (short):
1) raj — telemetry + alert for regional retry spike (ETA EOD today)
2) ben — route-update API circuit-breaker + exponential backoff (ETA +2 days)
3) simon — LB canary + safety-flag + rollback playbook (ETA tomorrow)
4) megan — run testbed replay for 3 days to validate (ETA +1 week)
Please add PR links when ready.

ben: starting a draft branch now. local repro of the 500 -> client fallback is flaky but i have logs. i'll push WIP PR: github.com/redwood/infra/compare/benchfix-277

megan: re: testbed, need list of query traces. raj can you export the 10 highest-volume 5-min windows?

raj: done. uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/2771239876/trace-5min-top10.json

simon: LB guardrail config snippet:
```json
{
  "cross_region_burst_limit": 50,
  "health_check_gate": true,
  "rollback_marker": "rb-2771239876"
}
```
I'll submit infra change request after ben's circuit-breaker is merged.

alyssa: Note for ops: during the incident we saw a DNS TTL mismatch — some edges cached old region routes ~2 minutes longer than control-plane intended. Need follow-up with registrar + edge caching TTLs. megan take point?

megan: yep, i'll put registrar contact + ticket in the incident board. tagging @sre-bot to schedule weekly recurrence check for next 4 weeks.

sre-bot: Scheduled: weekly "dns-reroute-stability-check" starting 2027-07-20, 09:00 UTC for 4 occurrences. Reminder sent to participants.

ben: quick log excerpt:
```
[2027-07-19T09:12:03Z] route-update failed 500 -> client fallback -> retry_count=4 -> region_hint=us-east,us-west
[2027-07-19T09:12:03Z] lb-forwarding: duplicate flows -> dropped=1200
```

raj: Adding alert thresholds:
- regional_retry_rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> Pager
- cross_region_flow_ratio > 10% -> SRE page

megan: can we also add a synthetic probe simulating route-update 500 with failover? helps catch regression.

simon: agree. sim probe in staging tomorrow.

alyssa: timeline check — please post status updates in this thread. we'll have a wrap sync Friday 16:00 UTC to validate fixes and agree on long-term guardrails.

ben: WIP PR link: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — circuit-breaker + backoff. please review.

megan: testbed job scheduled: job id tj-9988, replay starts 2027-07-20.

raj: dashboards: created new panel + alert: dashboard link: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/route-retries/277

simon: LB config PR: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/1987 (canary flag only). enabling canary in us-west next hour.

alyssa: thanks all. one more: postmortem follow-up doc will be updated with these action items. i'll export to the postmortems folder.

sre-bot: Incident updated: followups added -> 4 open action items. Last update 2027-07-19T10:05:00Z.
